propositions: Shutdown drain waits for webhook queue to empty but does not wait for in-flight reconciler reviews, allowing reconcile_loop to be cancelled within 10s while a review may still be in progress
Any container stop outside the autodeploy defer path (manual restart, compose-up.sh, host reboot, rollback) kills in-flight reconciler reviews with no drain budget
The reconciler must set a stop flag before shutdown begins to prevent new reviews from starting during the drain, maintaining a bounded shutdown deadline
The drain must share a single shutdown_drain_seconds() budget between queue.join() and reconciler in-flight wait to keep the existing stop_grace_period relationship valid
The stop flag must be cleared after shutdown completes, not at startup, to prevent it from persisting across process restarts and silently suppressing subsequent reconcile passes
